@graph.name: Knowledge base setup and AI-assisted support
@graph.description: Product information scattered across files and chat messages? Start with a set of documents and common questions, then organize a knowledge base and test answers with sources. Conflicting or unsupported information needs human review. Agents that change orders or stock require a separate assessment.

mainEntity.name: Do we have to train a model?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Assess existing models, retrieval and tool configuration against the task before investing in training.

mainEntity.name: Can an agent handle customer work autonomously?

acceptedAnswer.text: Validate a specific task first. Orders, payments, commitments and data changes need defined permissions, confirmations and exception handling before deciding the automation level.
